transcript: It just occurred to me that with Reeve Carney making his debut in The Great Gatsby last night, now all five principals from the original Hadestown cast are working on Broadway or off Broadway. Obviously we have Reeve and Eva in The Great Gatsby. Amber just started her run in Rocky Horror. Andre just started his run in cats, and then Patrick is doing Titus Andronicus off Broadway. And I guess this shouldn't be too surprising considering all five of these actors are pretty consistently booked and busy. Like, I don't think Eva has stopped working since leaving the show. Between three runs of The Great Gatsby and two runs of cabaret, Amber has done three Broadway shows as well. Patrick has done a ton of off Broadway shows, including his own solo show which he toured around the country. But it is still really fun to have the five of them back performing at the same time, which I actually don't think has happened since they all left HadesTown, excluding the like two or three performances that they all did together in London. And between this and the Pro Shot coming out in July, there really has not been a better time to be a Hadestown fan or a fan of these five actors. And I wanna know who is going to be the first person brave enough to do a four show weekend to see all five of them.
